අති විශෙෂ
No. 2435/48 – SATURDAY, MAY 10, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: WGSWD & EIP/ACQ/KB/41.
Ministry of Agriculture, Land, Livestock and

Irrigation Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2016/LRB/504. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government has acquired the allotments of the lands-for the widening and development of Ambalan Ela which runs across the Bus Route No. 120, under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project.

Description of the land to be acquired: An allotment of land depicted as Lot No. 01 in Sheet No. 06, Block No. 03 of the Cadastral Map No. 521239 dated 10.04.2025 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Katuwawala (Ward No. 09 of Katuwawala, within the Urban Council limits of Boralesgamuwa) in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 578 A of Katuwawala in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:
1. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Muththettuwa Wela Kumbura; Description: Home garden, a permanent building and a well is situated; Claimant: State; Original Claimant:
Mrs. Anoja Kumari Bulathsinghala, No. 75/74, Sandun Uyana, Mabulgoda, Pannipitiya; Extent: 0.0325 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 28.05.2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21.05.2025, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.

H. Thilakawardhana, Acquiring Officer, Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project. Divisional Secretary’s Division - Kesbewa. Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project. No. 03 Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya. 29th April, 2025. EOG 05 - 0034
